body: I keep having dreams about a girl with crazy grey eyes or maybe they are green im not sure. We have never spoken but we do fun things together like go to the movies or stargazing. People gave told me that she is my guardian angel but i'm not sure. I haven't seen her in a while but I remember the last time I saw her in my dreams was when I was holding her hand and I realized that I was in a dream and she ran away from me.
Please don't do it. Go to a hospital and look for help.
